description: Header file defining the AudioDecoder class for Android shared media, including method declarations, class members, and external dependencies related to audio decoding.

classes.name: AudioDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding audio streams on Android, managing decoding process, output, and error handling.

methods.name: AudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AudioDecoder with stream info, DRM system, and flush behavior.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads decoded audio data and outputs samples per second.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is properly initialized.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Sets up the media codec for decoding.

methods.name: ProcessOutputBuffer
methods.description: Processes output buffer from media codec.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Performs periodic decoder tasks; currently returns false.
